paragraphs.text: In today's headlines on conflict, presstv.co.uk reports at least three killed in Saudi airstrikes on the Yemen capital, and newsminer.com reports that the WHO reports at least 1,500 killed in new fighting in Yemen. Caribbeanherald.com reports 8 inmates killed in Ecuador prison riots, and allafrica.com reports that the army and Russia Africa Corp commit new abuses in Mali.

paragraphs.text: On work and AI, morningstar.com lists American Express to cut 3,500 jobs, and thestar.com.my reports Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs in an AI-driven push to lower costs. Fortune.com reports Goldman says AI could displace one in 11 workers, but the layoffs are waiting for a recession. Afr.com reports thousands of NAB staff are being forced to re-apply for their own jobs, and wcax.com reports VIP layoffs raise questions about AI's role in the Vermont workforce.
